QuestInfo.name: Daily Quest Board Explanation
QuestInfo.0: #p9310558# wants to explain the daily quest board to you. Speak with him.
QuestInfo.1:
#p9310558# explained how the daily quest board works.

1. Anyone can accept quests from the daily quest board.
2. Some quests are restricted by rank.
3. Quests change each day. You can only accept a set number per day.
4. You'll get #t4310177:# items for completing quests.
5. The amount of #t4310177:# items you get depends on the difficulty of the quest.

#bTip: To raise your reputation rank, help the town's residents by completing their quests.#k
